title: Encoding length for fan-in-two circuits
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a valid output vertex. Suppose each gate has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and each gate has at most two inputs. If the circuit size is $n$ plus its number of gates, then the length of its encoding is at most $12$ times the square of its size.
